cases.sentence: Ты отправляешься не к народу с невнятной речью и ___, а к дому Израиля.
cases.explain: «непонятным языком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel;

cases.sentence: Не к ___ с их невнятной речью и непонятным языком, чьи слова для тебя темны.
cases.explain: «многочисленным народам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

cases.sentence: Не к многочисленным народам с их невнятной речью и ___, чьи слова для тебя темны.
cases.explain: «непонятным языком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

cases.sentence: Не бойся, не страшись их, хотя они и ___.
cases.explain: «мятежный дом» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”

cases.sentence: Ступай теперь к ___ и поговори с ними.
cases.explain: «пленным землякам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.

cases.sentence: И был шум от крыльев ___, касавшихся друг друга, и стук от колес возле них, похожий на оглушительный грохот.
cases.explain: «живых существ» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

cases.sentence: И был шум от крыльев живых существ, касавшихся друг друга, и стук от колес возле них, похожий на ___.
cases.explain: «оглушительный грохот» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

cases.sentence: Если Я скажу нечестивому: «Ты непременно умрешь», — а ты не станешь его предостерегать и отговаривать от ___, чтобы спасти его жизнь, то злодей умрет за свой грех , а Я потребую у тебя ответа за его кровь.
cases.explain: «нечестивого пути» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

cases.sentence: Но если ты будешь предостерегать нечестивого, а он не отвернется ни от своего злодеяния, ни от ___, то он умрет за свой грех, а ты спасешь свою жизнь.
cases.explain: «нечестивого пути» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

cases.sentence: ___, которые он совершил, не вспомнятся, и Я потребую у тебя ответа за его кровь.
cases.explain: «Добрые дела» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.

cases.sentence: Я сделаю так, что твой язык прилипнет к нёбу, ты будешь молчать и не сможешь обличать их, хотя они и ___.
cases.explain: «мятежный дом» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, that you will be mute, and will not be able to correct them; for they are a rebellious house.

cases.sentence: Кто станет слушать, пусть слушает, а кто откажется, пусть отказывается, ведь это ___.
cases.explain: «мятежный дом» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”
